investorWithdraw.title: Request a withdrawal
investorWithdraw.amountFormat: Enter the amount in rupees, e.g. 25000.
investorWithdraw.rule1: The amount can't be more than what the company owes you on your account. Admin approves, the company pays from its bank, and you hear on WhatsApp.
investorWithdraw.rule2: Shares can't be drawn as cash. To leave, shares are transferred or bought back under company law.
